text:
When a small piece of a Group I metal is placed into a large beaker of cold water, a reaction
occurs.
Four statements about this reaction are listed.
1
The metal melts.
2
Hydrogen is produced.
3
Steam is produced.
4
The pH of the solution increases.
Which statements about this reaction describe a physical change?
A
1 and 3
B
1 and 4
C
2 and 3
D
2 and 4
subject: Chemistry
